instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
3. Exhale and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, curling your upper body toward your knees.
4. Lower your shoulder blades back down with control while inhaling.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with your abs, not by pulling on your neck.
2. Move slowly and with control to keep tension on the abs.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor and lean back slightly with your arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
2. Extend your legs straight out, parallel and just above the floor.
3. Exhale and pull both knees toward your chest while crunching your upper body up to meet them.
4. Bring your arms toward the sides of your knees as you crunch.
5. Extend your legs and open your arms back out with control while inhaling.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement with your abs, not momentum.
2. Keep your lower back stable and do not let it arch.
3. Exhale as you crunch in, inhale as you extend out.
4. Squeeze your abs hard at the top of each rep.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Extend your arms straight overhead with hands together, in line with your ears.
3. Exhale and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, keeping your arms extended.
4. Lower your shoulder blades back down with control while inhaling.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight and locked next to your ears throughout.
2. Lift with your abs, not momentum from your arms.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet just off the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
3. Exhale and lift your shoulder blades off the floor while bringing your knees toward your head.
4. Lower your upper back and legs back to the start with control while inhaling, keeping your feet off the floor.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with your abs, not by pulling on your neck.
2. Use a mat to support your back.
3. Exhale as you lift shoulders and knees, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your feet off the floor to maintain tension on the lower abs.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees and your lower legs resting on a stability ball.
2. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
3. Exhale and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, curling your upper body toward your knees.
4. Lower your shoulder blades back down with control while inhaling, keeping your legs on the ball.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your legs steady on the ball to challenge your core stability.
2. Lift with your abs, not by pulling on your neck.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Move slowly to maximize ab tension.
